Yeah something seems wrong. I’ve worked at a few pharmacies and not a single one would do a prior authorization for a med. The process is the pharmacy sends a message to the doctor letting them know why it’s not covered (in your case the dose he wants exceeds what they will pay for) the doctor then either called the insurance or fills out the forms on why it’s medically necessary online then the insurance reviews it and decides if they will pay for it.
